title: Pricing Methodology Summary
locator: Printed pp. 3–6; research, overhead, taxes, depreciation, publication frequency
supported_claim: Published prices describe researched markets, may be adjusted for a job, and do not cover every custom task. General contractor O&P, job-related costs and embedded personnel/subcontractor overhead have different treatment. Lists update at least monthly.
limitation: Methodology, not coverage, tax advice or a mandated markup; no Phoenix price verified. Fresh direct retrieval returned 401. Preserve this distinct summary; A-S25 is an accessible separate methodology paper, also dated 2023.
date_note: Date is document/adoption information, not proof of current applicability.

title: Downloading price lists
supported_claim: Project lists are selected in Claim Info > Parameters; requests can use city/ZIP or list name.
limitation: Does not establish which month governs a claim.

title: View item details in X1
supported_claim: Search for the item and use Click for detail.
limitation: Actual proprietary item contents require licensed lookup.

title: View or adjust line item components in X1
supported_claim: Components organizes estimate entries into equipment, materials and labor.
limitation: Software navigation does not validate task necessity.

title: XactScope roof and exterior prompt dependencies
supported_claim: Roof prompts depend on material, geometry and settings. Starter/ridge prompts interact with automatic waste; the documented felt-inclusion example is specifically a wood-roof item.
limitation: Do not apply that felt example to every assembly. A prompt is not proof of necessary or covered work.

title: Modify the item unit price in X1
supported_claim: Unit-price controls expose O&P, tax, price calculations, component details, trade and minimum group. Manual prices are marked green.
limitation: Changes require independent justification.

title: Attach or delete notes, images, or sound files to a line item in X1
supported_claim: F9 opens line notes; attachments can include images and PDF/DOCX/JPG documents.
limitation: Export and attachment visibility should be checked in delivered reports.

title: Apply labor minimums for a line item in X1
supported_claim: Labor minimums are displayed under Estimate Items; Apply and base amounts can be adjusted.
limitation: A setting is not proof a minimum is warranted or owed.

title: Variation Reports
supported_claim: Variation compares checkpoint and estimate items, showing price and component unit-price differences.
limitation: Not a full semantic comparison of two independent estimates.

title: Create a macro in Xactimate desktop
supported_claim: A macro is a saved list of line items for repeated tasks.
limitation: Saved lines must be validated for each job.

title: Load a macro in Xactimate desktop or online
supported_claim: Select a group, select a macro in the Macros pane, then Run.
limitation: No guarantee of suitable variables or scope.

title: Run an inspection for the entire estimate in desktop
supported_claim: Inspection operates during estimating and before completion; manually run Complete > INSPECT.
limitation: Software inspection is not physical roof inspection.

title: Use a checkpoint price list in desktop
supported_claim: Select checkpoint in Claim Info > Parameters; Variation can be exported to PDF.
limitation: Keep correct benchmark; a checkpoint is not a carrier scope.

title: Depreciation in Xactimate desktop
supported_claim: Controls include material, non-material (labor/equipment), removal, O&P, tax, recoverability and age/condition; available choices depend on configuration.
limitation: Help warns not every carrier/regulator allows every type. Do not infer Arizona law from available controls.

title: Export a project to your computer from Xactimate desktop
supported_claim: Close the project; desktop exports projects as ESX.
limitation: Handle claim data securely; no external transfer performed.

title: Building Construction Codes | City of Phoenix
publisher: City of Phoenix Planning & Development Department
supported_claim: Phoenix adopted the 2024 PBCC with an August 1, 2025 effective date and publishes amendments.
limitation: Verify permit/transition applicability and actual municipal jurisdiction.
date_note: Date is document/adoption information, not proof of current applicability.
verification_note: Luna technical check; root also inspected downloaded bytes for A-S16,17,19,20.

title: How to Obtain a Residential Permit Brochure
publisher: City of Phoenix Planning & Development Department
locator: PDF page 1, permit-needed and not-needed lists
supported_claim: The 2020 City brochure lists same-material re-shingle/re-tile work among permit exemptions and gives material-change/roofline-extension permit examples.
limitation: An older brochure is not a current project-specific code determination. Confirm the current AHJ, scope, structural/layer exceptions and adopted-code transition.
date_note: Date is document/adoption information, not proof of current applicability.
verification_note: Luna technical check; root also inspected downloaded bytes for A-S16,17,19,20.

title: Steep-Slope Pro Field Guide
supported_claim: Dust can interfere with sealing; blow-offs and granule loss have multiple causes. Guide addresses hand-sealing and individual shingle removal/replacement.
limitation: GAF-specific; diagnosis needs actual roof evidence; not a whole-roof replacement test.
verification_note: Luna technical check; root also inspected downloaded bytes for A-S16,17,19,20.

title: Concrete and Clay Roof Tile Installation Manual
supported_claim: Provides slope/system-dependent underlayment and flashing details, deck review, tile replacement and drainage provisions. Penetration detail shows deck and tile flashing.
limitation: Use correct table/evaluation report and manufacturer applicability; no universal breakage percentage or replacement mandate.
date_note: Date is document/adoption information, not proof of current applicability.
verification_note: Luna technical check; root also inspected downloaded bytes for A-S16,17,19,20.

title: How to Properly Replace Damaged Concrete Roof Tiles
supported_claim: Individual damaged tiles can be replaced, resulting underlayment holes patched, and compatible adhesive placed without obstructing drainage. Roof traffic is a possible breakage source.
limitation: Does not establish repairability of any actual roof.
date_note: Date is document/adoption information, not proof of current applicability.
verification_note: Luna technical check; root also inspected downloaded bytes for A-S16,17,19,20.

title: LIBERTY SBS Self-Adhering Installation Instructions
supported_claim: Example system includes deck preparation, primer, base/ply, cap, edge metal and detailed transitions/penetrations. Damage is repaired as necessary; cleanup and maintenance are separate steps.
limitation: Identified LIBERTY assembly/edition only. Related GAF materials differ on the lower slope bound (A-S27–29); obtain product-specific confirmation.
date_note: Date is document/adoption information, not proof of current applicability.
verification_note: Luna technical check; root also inspected downloaded bytes for A-S16,17,19,20.

title: Change the slope of a roof in X1
supported_claim: Roof Properties allows a slope-rise entry for each lettered roof face.
limitation: Input accuracy still requires measurement.

title: XactXpert Reports
supported_claim: Paid, activated XactXpert reporting can show scorecard/audit details and bypass reasons after inspection and Complete/upload to XactAnalysis.
limitation: Paid activation/configuration required; score is not independent proof of scope or coverage.

title: Calculating roof waste
supported_claim: For most RFG roofing-material items, waste can be entered through item settings/formulas or automatic Sketch calculations.
limitation: No standard percentage or job-specific waste conclusion supplied.

title: Pricing Research Methodology
locator: PDF pp. 4–8: markets, frequency, item detail, verification requests and summary
supported_claim: Published market prices assume common job conditions; estimators may adjust for a specific job. Localized lists are normally monthly and can be more frequent during surges; item assemblies are inspectable.
limitation: Accessible official publication, not established as a newer edition. It provides no specific Phoenix price, coverage decision or automatic adjustment.
verification_method: Luna official web retrieval plus root PDF download/text inspection.

title: X-Tenda Coat Coating System — Restoration Coatings
locator: PDF pp. 1–5, 7–13, 16–23, 29–31: assessment, restrictions, substrate compatibility and repair details
supported_claim: Carlisle restoration guidance calls for assessment and adhesion testing, recommends moisture investigation where indicated, and distinguishes suitable coating substrates from conditions needing repairs or replacement consideration. It covers selected SPF, asphaltic and single-ply substrates.
limitation: Commercial product specification; transfer to a residential roof requires actual assembly/product applicability. Not a Phoenix code, storm-causation finding or coverage rule.

title: LIBERTY Roll Roofing System Products
supported_claim: System page repeats 1/4:12–3:12 and points to 2,500 sq. ft. note.
limitation: Retained to document conflicting product statements; no slope threshold is selected for a real job. Resolve product, assembly, edition and manufacturer requirements.

title: LIBERTY Self-Adhering Cap Sheet
supported_claim: Cap-sheet product page says 1/2:12–3:12 and separately describes use with LIBERTY base/ply.
limitation: Retained to document conflicting product statements; no slope threshold is selected for a real job. Resolve product, assembly, edition and manufacturer requirements.

title: LIBERTY Self-Adhering Cap Sheet sell sheet RESLB117
supported_claim: Current sell sheet says 1/4:12–3:12 for cap sheet when paired with base/ply.
limitation: Retained to document conflicting product statements; no slope threshold is selected for a real job. Resolve product, assembly, edition and manufacturer requirements.
